output.summary: An evergreen shrub native to Eurasia and parts of northern Africa, butcher's-broom has flat, stiff shoots that resemble spine-tipped leaves. Small greenish flowers appear singly at their centres in spring, followed on female plants by red berries.
output.edibilityNote: The berries caused reported poisonings, mostly in children, including 107 cases in 1995–2007 and four acute cases in Lombardy in 2010–2011.
